title: Jeffer S NDE 20542
content:
I felt a couple of jolts through my body as if I was being shocked. After the shock had disappeared, I looked down toward earth to find that the dentist was still trying to take out my wisdom teeth. After looking down, I couldn't help but go to houses of family members. Some of them were drinking and some were sitting down chatting or watching television. As I drifted up further to this white light, I heard a voice calling me. This voice was peaceful and heartwarming. As I was about to go further into this light, I was approached by a man dressed in white with his hair down to his shoulders. He showed me the sky and said, ‘Son, this is what you've been doing with your life. I am quite pleased and will reward you with pleasurable eternal life for the wrongs that have been put against you.’ This man showed me a time in my life where he saw it was the lowest, when I lost my twin brother to suicide. He also showed me a meadow that was filled with people going across a river. A peaceful river. Those who were thirsty drank of it. This man put my brother's hand in mine then told him to bring me back. I felt a big swoosh and was struggling to get back into my body. I saw doctors and nurses using all their might and will to try to get me back. After a half an hour of trying, they got me back and stabilized.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: A man dressed in white with hair down to his shoulders; addressed the experiencer as 'Son' and spoke of being pleased and rewarding him with 'pleasurable eternal life'.
arrival.other_being_detail: Twin brother (deceased by suicide) appeared; the man put the brother's hand in the experiencer's and told the brother to bring him back.

environment.environment_other_detail: Meadow filled with people going across a peaceful river; those who were thirsty drank of it.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a 'big swoosh' and struggled to get back into the body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred during wisdom teeth extraction at the dentist; experiencer felt 'a couple of jolts' as if being shocked; later reports doctors and nurses trying to get him back and stabilizing him after about half an hour.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Visited houses of living family members and observed them drinking, chatting, or watching television.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with observation of dentist and living family members occurred before drifting up toward a white light and encountering a man in white; brief review-like scenes followed; then return was initiated by the man and the deceased brother.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Observation/visiting of living family members' houses during the OBE; statement promising 'pleasurable eternal life for the wrongs that have been put against you.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Son, this is what you've been doing with your life. I am quite pleased and will reward you with pleasurable eternal life for the wrongs that have been put against you.”; “I felt a big swoosh and was struggling to get back into my body.”
